dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Little Nara in Vimara Village don't know how to farm... but other Nara cannot see Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is something worrying you?

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's Nara {NICKNAME}. Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: I am curious, about Nara's way of farming. They don't praise flowers, or sing to fruit trees.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: But their way makes trees happy, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Do you know how they do that, Nara {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Viparyas...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Viparyas are very happy. Happier than hearing any song by Arakara and Aranakula.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Is it because of meeting the Golden Nara?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Thank you for helping Arakara, Nara {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fertilizing and watering?

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Watering, that I understand. Plants like water, like how I love farming.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: "Fea-ther-lizing"... What is that?

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Giving feathers to fruit trees to make them fly...?

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Marana has been defeated, so Vana has more lands for farming now. But Valuka is still no good...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Marana...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Thanks to Nara {NICKNAME}, there are no more traces of Marana in Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: The land that was once polluted by Marana can now hear the laughter of Viparyas.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #When Nara {NICKNAME} comes to Vana next time, you will definitely see greener green than now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Valuka...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Valuka is different from Vana. All the earth has turned into golden remains.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: No Aranara have been there, not even Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: But I heard there are Nara farming in Valuka. I wonder how do the Nara there make the flowers happy.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #If Nara {NICKNAME} goes to Valuka someday, can you ask the Nara there about this for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Be careful if you are going to Valuka.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}. I hope that one day, Viparyas flowers can also bloom on Valuka land.
